name: Growrk
description:
Connect Claude to your GroWrk workspace so you can run device and IT asset lifecycle operations through natural language, without switching tools.

Use it to:

Track orders and shipments. Check status, delivery timelines, courier tracking, and full order history across regions.

Query inventory and assets. Look up devices, assignments, specs, and availability in real time.

Deploy and recover devices. Initiate deployments to team members anywhere, and handle onboarding, asset assignment, and offboarding with device recovery.

Open maintenance and repair orders. Raise maintenance, collect-for-maintenance, and swap-from-inventory requests, then follow their status and shipment history through to delivery.

GroWrk applies your existing dashboard permissions: you only see and act on the teams, regions, and records your role already allows, and every write is limited to the scopes you grant at sign-in.

Built for IT, operations, and people teams managing hardware across distributed and remote workforces, GroWrk turns multi-step asset workflows into a single conversational request.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Growrk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Growrk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.growrk.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Growrk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Growrk lists 16 MCP tools, including add_power_accessory, create_employee, create_order, get_assigned_devices, get_device_options, get_employee, get_order, get_order_history, get_tracking, list_employees, list_orders, and search_inventory.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Growrk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Growrk in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Growrk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Growrk is developed by Growrk Remote. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
